verdicts.quote: Use a Lightning Web Component exposed as a `lightning__Tab` target … A dedicated tab provides a short internal path and does not place the composer in a record context
The application reads, queries and writes no Salesforce business records. Row sharing, object CRUD and field permissions are inapplicable to such data because the bot uses none.
verdicts.missing: Record-based answers are outside the design. There is no rule for executing a record query in the asking user’s sharing context.

verdicts.quote: Row sharing, object CRUD and field permissions are inapplicable to such data because the bot uses none.
verdicts.missing: The specification excludes CRM fields altogether. It gives no field-level access or masking rule for reading and displaying restricted or encrypted fields.

verdicts.quote: The org administrator owns the feature metadata, navigation, grants and authorized recovery … A dedicated permission set and assignment control feature visibility, Apex access and use of the external credential principal.

users never receive credentials, raw headers, raw provider envelopes or other users’ text. … Memory only for the active view and user. … Nothing is written to browser storage, URL, Salesforce records or an application transcript.
The browser waits asynchronously for the user-initiated Salesforce invocation. The Salesforce-to-xAI exchange is a foreground request/response.
verdicts.missing: The specification describes the external call but gives no trigger or post-DML transaction restriction and no asynchronous Apex job for the callout.

verdicts.quote: Use a Salesforce Named Credential with fixed origin `https://api.x.ai` and a linked External Credential … Keep the configured value out of source metadata, the client, tests and logs.
S3 documents 100 callouts and 120 seconds cumulative callout time per transaction, and lists 6 MB as the synchronous callout request/response size limit.
verdicts.missing: The numeric Apex heap and CPU time limits are missing. The 6 MB figure bounds callout size.

verdicts.quote: Expect zero outbound requests for missing key or an invocation rejection injected before dispatch, and one attempted callout for injected provider/transport results.
verdicts.missing: Injected responses are specified, but there is no requirement for Apex tests to replace real HTTP callouts with a mock implementation.

verdicts.quote: Use a Salesforce Named Credential with fixed origin `https://api.x.ai` and a linked External Credential using Custom authentication with a restricted named principal.
verdicts.missing: The configured host is explicit. The specification does not state that Salesforce refuses a callout to an unregistered endpoint.

verdicts.quote: Invocation is imperative, non-cacheable Apex, with a single request/response per admitted Send. … Current completion before deadline displays R-2’s answer and releases controls.
Delayed or repeated completions are ignored once the attempt terminates, expires or the view ends.
verdicts.missing: Deduplication is scoped to the mounted view. There is no message- or request-level idempotency rule for a retried or re-enqueued worker.

verdicts.quote: Timeout, no transport, upstream 5xx or platform invocation failure without a known more specific classification | “No reply received. Send again.”
verdicts.missing: Provider rejections have classified messages, but upstream 5xx and timeout share one user-visible outcome.

verdicts.quote: Provider rate or quota limit | “Grok is busy. Wait and send again.” Resending is manual and can fail again until the provider permits it.
a provider output cap reached with an incomplete response yields the incomplete status, with zero partial answer displayed. … “No reply received. Send again.”

Clear, refresh, exit or observed account change empties the view. … xAI separately documents default encrypted abuse-audit retention for 30 days with automatic expiry, or the applicable team agreement/control.
verdicts.missing: Local and provider retention are addressed, but the specification does not say what deleting a Salesforce user means for remaining provider-held text.

verdicts.quote: send one fresh question per request, with no previous answer, client identity or Salesforce data attached … The UI states before Send that text goes to xAI and instructs users to use synthetic or approved non-sensitive text.

send one fresh question per request, with no previous answer … 1 through 4,000 UTF-16 code units inclusive after trim … A provider input/context rejection yields the generic upstream rejection, and never silently truncates the question.

Initially empty. … empty and whitespace-only input with “Enter a message as text.” … 1 through 4,000 UTF-16 code units inclusive … at most 512 visible output tokens … A complete reply at the cap can display.
the administrator withdraws affected feature visibility/grants … Authorized maintainers can rotate/disable it without altering bot code. … An unavailable model requires an explicit decision revision.
verdicts.missing: Administrative shutdown is possible through grants or credentials. No administrator model-change mechanism or administrator view of failed bot requests is specified.

verdicts.quote: deployment, visibility/access assignment and credential readiness have separate evidence … A single development-team credential backs the bot.
verdicts.missing: The development deployment and credential are addressed. The production configuration, credential separation, promotion route and required production Apex code coverage are unspecified.

Empty, validation, waiting, answer and service error are visibly differentiated and usable. … “Grok couldn’t complete this reply. Revise or shorten your message and send again.”
